summary: Optional bearer-token auth. Token = env ORCH_TOKEN or BASE/token file (null = OFF, back-compat). When set, /mcp + writes (/reset, /overlay/*, /loop/start|stop) require it via Authorization: Bearer, x-orch-token header, or ?token= query (connector URLs can carry it). Reads stay open. mcp-core.readToken() + makeCall auto-send the Bearer header so stdio + self-calls auth. Daemon helper authed(req,u). Also added: workspace persistence (BASE/workspace) so respawns restore it.
